# Pinned TimeMixer reference

These files are byte-identical copies from `kwuking/TimeMixer` commit
`e24610583b36fdd8c76cc17a8df4e65759a5f460`. They are test-only reference
sources for numerical parity and must not be edited independently.

Checksums and Git blob identities are recorded in
`src/modeling_module/models/TimeMixer/upstream_manifest.json`. The upstream
Apache-2.0 license is preserved at
`src/modeling_module/models/TimeMixer/LICENSE.upstream`.
